tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultancy Firm / Company should have been involved in the Civil Engineering Consultancy Services i.e. TP, quality control for works for last 10 years as a prime consultant and the Intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as a prime Consultant, at least one work (Third Party) i.e costing not less than 50% of the amount Put to tender i,eRs.3.99 Lakhs during Last Five Financial years reckoned back from2024-25 (i,e work executed during 2020-21 to 2024-25 will be considered) The work done certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division/Equivalent officer. The cost will be updated to the present value by giving a weight age of 10% per annum, if the work is completed prior to the year 2025-26.

The Intending bidder should have in the last five financial period (i.e. 2020-21 to 2024-25) achieved in at least two financial years, an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 7.98 lakhs. The financial turnover shall be certified by the registered Charted Accountant, All Documents/Certificates issued by Charted Accountant should have a UDIN generated through the ICAI Portal, Any Such Certificate without UDIN shall not be considered and shall be treated as invalid document. Financial turnover of previous year shall be given a weight age of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY 2025-26
